bullets.text: PowerToys AI Clipboard Upgrade - **Microsoft** enhances clipboard management with AI-powered features for versatile content pasting.
Access Fabric Unveiled - **Microsoft** introduces a unified approach to identity and network access for enhanced security.
Windows 11 Insider Build Released - New features in **Windows 11** enhance gaming and settings management for users.
Critical React Vulnerability Alert - **Microsoft** warns about a severe RCE vulnerability affecting React Server Components.
Leader in AI Defense - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in KuppingerCole's report for Generative AI Defense.
GPT-5.2 Launch in Foundry - **Microsoft Foundry** introduces GPT-5.2, setting a new standard for enterprise AI capabilities.
GPT-5.2 in Microsoft 365 - **Microsoft 365 Copilot** integrates GPT-5.2 for enhanced strategic insights and productivity.
Fake Employee Cyberattacks - **Microsoft** highlights the rising threat of cybercriminals posing as legitimate employees.
